dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified run is restricted to packages satisfying every condition encoded by D010; these conditions are implicit hypotheses of the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003

binders: n is an implicitly quantified natural number.

run is an arbitrary inhabitant of LocalDef001 n. Unpacked, it contains n-by-n real matrices A and Ainv; a real vector b; vector sequences x_k, rHat_k, dHat_k, deltaR_k, and deltaX_k for every natural k; a matrix sequence G_k; real scalars uR, u, uS, and uF; and a matrix sequence M_k=M1_k, together with all hypotheses listed below.
i is an arbitrary natural number, with no upper bound or finite iteration horizon.
j is an arbitrary element of Fin(n), so 0<=j<n. Every vector has n real components and every matrix is n by n.
hypotheses: The run contains a proof that 0<n.
Let m be the maximum row count defined below. The run requires m uR<1.
Ainv is an exact two-sided inverse of A: for every real vector z, Ainv(Az)=z and A(Ainv z)=z componentwise.
For every natural k and indices p,q in Fin(n), G_k[p,q]>=0.
For every k and p, rHat_k[p]=b[p]-(A x_k)[p]+deltaR_k[p]=r_k[p]+deltaR_k[p].
For every k and p, |rHat_k[p]-(A dHat_k)[p]|<=uS(G_k|dHat_k|)[p].
For every k and p, x_(k+1)[p]=x_k[p]+dHat_k[p]+deltaX_k[p].
Writing N for exactly the matrix norm used by D024, for every k, uS N(G_k|Ainv|)+(1+uS)gamma N(|A||Ainv|)<=1/2.
For every k and p,q, M_k[p,q]>=0.
For every k and every real vector z, M_k((I-Q_k)z)=z componentwise.
conclusions: For every natural i and every j in Fin(n), |r_(i+1)[j]| <= (B_i|r_i|)[j] + (1+uS)(1+u)gamma(c_(i+1)[j] + (M_i Q_i c_(i+1))[j]) + u(|A||x_(i+1)|)[j].
mathematical_definitions: Fin(n) is the set of component indices {0,...,n-1}. All sums below range over Fin(n).
For a matrix C and vector y, (Cy)[p]=sum_q C[p,q]y[q]. For matrices C and D, (CD)[p,q]=sum_s C[p,s]D[s,q].
Absolute values of vectors and matrices are entrywise: |y|[p]=|y[p]| and |C|[p,q]=|C[p,q]|.
For each row p, s_p is the number of q for which A[p,q] is not zero, plus 1 if b[p] is not zero and 0 otherwise. Then m=max_p s_p.
gamma=(m uR)/(1-m uR), where m is cast from a natural number to a real number.
The exact residual is r_k=b-Ax_k, componentwise.
I is the n-by-n identity matrix, with I[p,q]=1 when p=q and I[p,q]=0 otherwise.
N(C) is exactly Matrix.linftyOpNormedRing.norm applied to C. The supplied packet does not unfold the source norm sufficiently to replace N by a componentwise closed formula.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every admissible positive-dimensional run and every iteration i and component j, the magnitude of the exact residual at component j after the next update is bounded componentwise by the propagation matrix B_i applied to the current absolute residual, plus an explicit error term involving gamma, the scale vector c_(i+1), M_i Q_i, and |A||x_(i+1)|. All run equations, inverse assumptions, nonnegativity conditions, scalar order conditions, and matrix-norm bounds are hypotheses encoded in the type of run.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The declaration does not assert that an admissible run exists. It is universally quantified over run : LocalDef001 n, so it is vacuously true whenever that type has no inhabitants.
For n=0 the proposition is necessarily vacuous because constructing a run requires 0<n; independently, Fin(0) has no possible j.
Even for n>0, the exact inverse, smallness, nonnegativity, inverse identity for M_k, norm bound, and all iteration equations may make the run type empty.
The iteration index i is unrestricted. Every sequence in the run must be defined for all natural-number iterations; no stopping criterion or finite horizon is encoded.
Ainv is required to be an exact two-sided inverse of A, not merely an approximate inverse.
M_k is supplied as part of the run. The proposition does not construct it or state uniqueness; it assumes M_k(I-Q_k)z=z for every z, entrywise nonnegativity, and N(M_k)<=2.
The condition m uR<1 and uR>=0 makes 1-m uR positive, so gamma's displayed denominator is nonzero for every admissible run.
The sparsity quantity m uses exact real nonzero tests and also counts b[p] when it is nonzero.
The constants 1/2 and 2 are exact real numbers.
uF affects admissibility only through uS<=uF and does not occur in the conclusion or the other displayed bounds.
No upper bound such as uF<1 is encoded.
The conclusion is only a componentwise one-step residual inequality. It does not itself state convergence, termination, a global normwise residual bound, forward stability, or backward stability.
All arithmetic in the proposition is exact real arithmetic; floating-point behavior is represented only through the packaged equations and inequalities.
There are no existential witnesses in the target. All auxiliary vectors, matrices, parameters, and their proofs are already packaged in the universally quantified run.
ambiguities: The body of D080 inherits its norm from Matrix.linftyOpSemiNormedRing, but that source declaration is not unfolded in the dossier. Therefore the packet fixes the exact Lean norm instance but does not independently expose a standalone componentwise formula for it; the translation preserves this norm as N rather than assuming, solely from its name, that it equals a particular max-row-sum formula.
